The user wants to arrange a flight on booking number 1234, check different options. They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport code, travel_to last airport code, travel_class business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? They want to arrange a flight on booking number 1234. Possibly we need to book flight? But they want to check different options. They want to compute cost. So we need to get flight cost. Then maybe we need to compute total payable amount including insurance? Not specified. Just estimated total payable amount. So we can just provide the cost.

We need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost. Then maybe we need to compute total payable amount. But we don't have card or booking. We can just provide cost.

We might need to authenticate first? The get_flight_cost doesn't require authentication. So we can call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Then provide cost.

We also might need to contact customer support? No.

Thus steps: call get_all_airports. Then parse list. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2024-10-31, travel_class=business. Then output cost.

Let's do that.
